prompt:
No host portrait. No woman. No Victoria. No Виктория.png. No presenter face. Style lock collage = palette only (#111111 + white heavy sans + #ff006e), not a face.
Одно статичное PNG 3:4@4K, сетка 3×3. Thin white gutters at 1/3 and 2/3 (Excalibur seam_slice). Текст ≥12% от швов. Animals + objects only. Без видео. English text in quotes:

01 cat, waveform, 09:11 clock: "Voice notes till 2 AM. Morning: “In a meeting”" / "And radio silence until nightfall. How Sunday intimacy turned into cold office wall in seven hours.".
02 dog at closed door, muted phone: "Whiplash hurts more than silence" / "Last night you felt cherished. By noon you feel like an inconvenient disruption in his calendar.".
03 muted phone, pause pills: "The trap: freezing your day on pause" / "Checking his status every 15 minutes, making excuses for him, and putting your life on hold while he works undisturbed.".
04 laptop, calendar leaf, toggle: "Monday’s emotional toggle switch" / "At 9 AM he locks into task mode. But intense workloads never cancel out basic warmth and respect for the bond.".
05 owl, decoder table: "Decoder: what he says vs what it means" / "“Crazy Monday” → you aren't factored into his day even for 5 seconds. “Catch up later” → dialogue relegated to leftover energy.".
06 meeting pills 1-2-3: "3 checks: workload or distance?" / "1. Is there warmth in brief replies? 2. Does he reach out after meetings? 3. Or do you exist only when he's bored?".
07 office coffee cup: "How to reclaim your Monday" / "1. Step off standby duty at your screen. 2. Realign focus onto your own weekly goals. 3. Reply on your own timeline, not instantly.".
08 gold medallion, Mon 31 leaf: "The adult connection rule" / "A man in focus never leaves you in the dark: he offers clarity even in a packed schedule. Your worth is never measured by his meetings.".
09 huge magenta MONDAY, coffee, muted phone, no person: "Comment MONDAY" / "Audio reading in the app. Essence–Shadow–Vector.".

animals as emotion metaphors (cat 01, dog 02, owl 05)
safe text margin >= 12% from edges and seams

huge magenta trigger word MONDAY on slide 9

weekend sofa-vacuum hero (sofa + face-down Friday phone as motif)

horror elements, blood, skulls, dripping candles
